blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 24 contains 31 verses. It opens with: And the courses of the sons of Aaron `were these'. The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar. It concludes with: These likewise cast lots even as their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' `houses' of the priests and of the Levites; the fathers' `houses' of the chief even as those of his younger brother. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The detailed Levitical, musical, and administrative orders may preserve earlier traditions while also reflecting and authorizing later temple institutions; direct projection to one moment in David's reign is historically disputed.
